# Strategy, cadence and trajectory

Civil Case No. 26-360, Zschoche v. Balane, MTC Mercedes · as of 21 October 2026, after counsel's reply of 21 October · internal; supersedes the cadence parts of the 14 Oct proof plan and the 15 Oct trap map where they differ. Nothing here is filed or sent. Tags: [VERIFY] · [COUNSEL] · [JONATHAN].

**Where we stand.**

- **The case is won on paper.** Article 1898: the agent sold outside the class written in paragraph 7 (their own Answer says they rented; their own receipts have nothing from Llamanzares and put the only down payment in 2005); the owners never ratified; the limits were on the title from 1996, and their Answer says Gloria "checked the SPA."

- **Jonathan has testified.** King is next on 4 November; counsel briefs her. The jurat question is closed. Patricia comes on rebuttal by videoconference; counsel will move.

- **The one open fact is theirs to prove:** the 1980s down payment. It has no paper. It becomes testimony only if Gloria's excluded affidavit is admitted, and her own papers answer it.

- **We do not yet hold** the 13 May Pre-Trial Order (witness order, any reservation of additional documents) or the transcript of 14 October. Both are requested below.
